title: Business Office Cash Handling Standard: Deposits to the School Nutrition Services Meal Account and Returned Checks
content:
**§1 Online deposits.** Online card deposits are accepted from the online deposit minimum to the online deposit maximum per deposit; the payment processor's online processing fee is paid by the family to the processor on top of the deposit and is never posted to the School Nutrition Services Meal Account.

**§2 Register deposits.** Cash and checks are accepted at the cafeteria register by the cafeteria deposit methods (cash at the register, check at the register).

**§3 Which accounts take deposits.** A deposit may be made to an active or an inactive account (an inactive account takes deposits only to clear unpaid meal charges), never to a closed account. The account status on the meal account record decides this.

**§4 Returned checks.** A check deposit returned unpaid by the bank is removed from the balance in full, which may make the balance negative.

**§5 No checks after a return.** After a returned check in the school year, check deposits are not accepted for any meal account of the household for the rest of that school year. The count is of returned deposits on any meal account of the household whose return date falls in the school year (July 1 to June 30) containing the decision date, as the household's meal account records show.

## Acceptance table

| Account status | Deposit accepted |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| inactive | yes, only to clear unpaid meal charges |
| closed | no |

| Returned deposits on any household meal account this school year (July 1 to June 30) | Check deposit at the register |
|---|---|
| none | accepted |
| one or more | not accepted for the rest of that school year |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A household's check of 40.00 deposited on one child's account in October is returned in November; the 40.00 is removed from that account, leaving it 12.35 below zero. From then until June 30 no check is accepted for any of the household's meal accounts; cash and online card deposits still are.
